guard: unread badges count live arrivals and stay honest at the retention cap, the roster tags the harness, and a deleted channel leaves the strip
why: The suite drives bin/cotal.ts, which imports @cotal-ai/cli from dist: a mutation must be built to be seen, and the tree must be rebuilt after the restore or dist keeps the mutant.
Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file.

mutations.name: G1 viewing a channel does not pin its watermark
mutations.find: if (activeChannel !== "all" && cur !== undefined && next[activeChannel] !== cur) bump(activeChannel, cur);
mutations.replace: if (activeChannel === "all" && cur !== undefined && next[activeChannel] !== cur) bump(activeChannel, cur);
mutations.expectRed: viewing pinned the watermark: the next message is +1, not +3
mutations.cell: viewing pinned the watermark: the next message is +1, not +3
mutations.note: Messages the operator has already looked at keep counting as unread.

mutations.name: G2 tag the wrong harness
mutations.expectRed: roster shows the harness tag next to the name
mutations.cell: roster shows the harness tag next to the name

mutations.name: G3 merge the channel list instead of rebuilding it
mutations.expectRed: delchan: the deleted channel's tab is gone on the next poll
mutations.cell: delchan: the deleted channel's tab is gone on the next poll
mutations.note: A deleted channel keeps its last count in the strip forever; seen live on the e2e mesh as `#scratch 2 +2` after :delchan.

mutations.name: G4 badge from retained depth instead of arrivals
mutations.expectRed: a live message on a channel at the retention cap still badges +1 (arrivals, not retained depth)
mutations.cell: a live message on a channel at the retention cap still badges +1 (arrivals, not retained depth)
mutations.note: The broker's per-sender cap pins the retained count at 1,000, so a badge built on it never moves under live traffic (console-reviewer's reproduction).

mutations.name: G5 a channel without a watermark is treated as already read
mutations.expectRed: a channel that first appears after startup badges its first message (+1), no baseline swallows it
mutations.cell: a channel that first appears after startup badges its first message (+1), no baseline swallows it
mutations.note: The empty-mesh defect console-reviewer reproduced: the first live channel's first arrival counted as read.
